meta.title: Testing Contract — 9-layer pyramid with helpers by layer

layer.name: view
layer.target: ViewDefinition + all its patterns + mock providers

layer.name: step
layer.target: StepDefinition: route matching + guards + view mount

layer.name: provider-contract
layer.target: Provider returns capability shapes that match TypeScript types

layer.name: visual-regression
layer.target: Storybook stories rendered + compared to baseline (Chromatic/Percy)

layer.name: e2e
layer.target: Full Inventory + real router + real localStorage adapter
layer.helper: Playwright tests against pnpm dev server

layer.name: mutation
layer.target: Stryker.js mutates selectors and invariants, expects tests to catch

budget-gates.gate: Bundle size: each pattern ≤ 80kb gzip — size-limit enforced.
Test coverage ≥ 80% for packages/, ≥ 60% for apps/.
Mutation score ≥ 70% for selectors and pure invariants.

gates.gate: Every Pattern has L1 + L2 tests.
Every View has L3 test + L6 story.
Every Provider has L5 contract test.
Every app has at least 1 L8 (E2E) happy path.
CI runs L1-L7 on every PR; L8-L9 on main + nightly.
